cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under themes preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify themes preferences behavior when themes list is empty
cases.description: Check the themes preferences panel behavior and display when neither Classic nor Modern themes are loaded.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display on low-resolution displays
cases.description: Check that the Classic theme rendering adapts correctly and matches the given image under low-resolution display settings.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display against reference image
cases.description: Navigate to the Modern theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme under high-contrast OS settings
cases.description: Apply high-contrast OS settings and verify the visual display of the Modern theme against the reference image expectations.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item when View menu is disabled
cases.description: Verify the state and availability of the 'Theme Preferences' item under the View menu when the View menu itself is disabled.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the Get New Themes item is available and clickable.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes behavior without network access
cases.description: Click the Get New Themes item under the View menu when network access is unavailable and verify the handling.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Classic item selection state when already active
cases.description: Check the selection state of the 'Classic' item under the View menu when the Classic theme is already active.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and confirm that the 'Modern' menu item is present and available.

cases.title: Verify selection state when Modern theme is already active
cases.description: Check the selection indicator or state of the 'Modern' item under the View menu when the Modern theme is currently active.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases introduce several untested failure modes and edge conditions (e.g., empty themes list, disabled View menu, network access failures, low-resolution displays, and high-contrast settings) that are not grounded in the requirements and make assumptions about application behavior beyond R-175 through R-181. Please remove these speculative scenarios and restrict test cases strictly to the stated functional requirements.
confirmed_blockers: Test cases G-002, G-004, G-006, G-008, G-010 introduce unsupported expected behaviors or requirements regarding empty theme lists, resolution adaptations, high-contrast settings, disabled menus, and network unavailability which are not specified in requirements R-175 to R-181.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to themes preferences and verifying both Classic and Modern themes exist. Boundary scenarios include checking behavior when only one theme is loaded or preferences are empty. For R-176: Normal scenario includes verifying Classic theme matches the given image. Edge scenario includes checking Classic theme under low-resolution displays. For R-177: Normal scenario includes verifying Modern theme matches the given image. Edge scenario includes checking Modern theme under high-contrast OS settings. For R-178: Normal scenario includes opening the View menu and verifying 'Theme Preferences' is present. Abnormal scenario includes verifying menu state when the View menu is disabled. For R-179: Normal scenario includes checking 'Get New Themes' under the View menu. Abnormal scenario includes verifying behavior when network access is unavailable. For R-180: Normal scenario includes verifying the 'Classic' item under the View menu. Edge scenario includes checking selection state when Classic is already active. For R-181: Normal scenario includes verifying the 'Modern' item under the View menu. Edge scenario includes checking selection state when Modern is already active.
